title: Route early preview feedback to the correct OCV area
summary: Early Access Preview feedback now routes to the correct OCV feedback area instead of appearing in the general feedback category.
key_points: Feedback from the Early Access Preview Features page was sent without OCV area metadata and landed in the general feedback area
Feedback at release level and at feature level now goes to the EarlyAccessPreview area
Feedback prompts and feature names stay the same
Only routing metadata passed to the platform feedback API is added
quote: Early Access Preview feedback was submitted without OCV area metadata, causing it to appear in the general feedback area.
